paragraphs: Catalis sells software and payment services to government agencies. One line covers tax and CAMA work, supporting local billing, collection and management alongside appraisal and assessing. Another handles courts and land records, automating filings and widening public access to justice.

On the resident-facing side, the company offers municipalities a package covering website design, development, hosting and maintenance. Its notification tool distributes messages by email, text, social media and voice phone lines. Administrators can also automate alerts drawn from Alert Ready, NOAA and IPAWS. Permitting and licensing tools let residents apply online and route the reviews to staff.

The stated customer base spans municipalities, counties, states and federal agencies. The website design team says it has been doing this work since 1999. It claims more than 1,000 municipal websites built to date. The notification platform is described as incorporating 20 years of municipal experience.

quote.text: Catalis is the transformational SaaS and integrated payments partner powering all levels and sizes of government
